consumer_jobs.name: ios-ui (planning-pickup)
consumer_jobs.result: XCTest runner received SIGKILL before establishing its test connection. The app UI cases did not start.

planning_pickup_failure.follow_up: The workflow waits for the simulator to finish booting before launching XCTest. It restarts the simulator and retries once after the recorded pre-connection signal kill, provided no case started. The original and retry logs and result bundles are retained separately. The exact bootstatus command reached Finished on a shut-down local iPhone simulator. Hosted retest remains open.

retry_shell_validation.scope: The YAML-parsed Bash step was exercised with simulator and Xcode command stand-ins and the exact hosted failure log. Six cases passed. A direct pass ran once. A pre-connection kill rebooted and retried. A failed assertion and a kill after case start did not retry. A repeated kill and a failed simulator boot surfaced failure. The retry kept the original test selectors.

split_workflow.scope: Both actual hosted consumers restored the same artifact. The planning and pickup consumer failed during XCTest startup. The comparison and context consumer was still running.
